AI questions and summaries · coming later
Set up on-device AI below. Document questions and summaries will follow device testing. You can inspect labelled document values now.
Import original files, search indexed text, inspect extracted page evidence, export a copy, and delete files from your encrypted vault.
This build does not upload documents or send text to a model provider.
Extraction and local search use stored source text. Citation-based AI answers require a verified model and further evaluation.
Choose one source to inspect supported English labels in its extracted text. Values are copied from that source, not generated by AI.
Choose the exact document you mean. Import order does not establish which policy is current.
Import a document in Documents first. Then return here to select its source.
Reading labelled values from this source…
Document facts could not be read. The original is preserved.
No supported labels were found. Open page text to check extraction or run OCR for scanned pages. Other wording and layouts may not match yet.
Some pages do not have complete extracted text. Values or conflicts may be missing. Review the source and extract text where needed.
Only part of the text was inspected. These results may omit values or conflicts; check the source.
Different values found. No single value has been chosen. Check each source page.
These are labelled text matches, not verified policy validity or financial advice. OCR can change digits. Check the original before relying on important values. Dates retain the source formatting.
Supported labels include policy and invoice identifiers, vehicle registration, policy holder, coverage dates, premium, tax, insured value, sum insured, deductible, and invoice total.
This app variant has no internet permission.
Network permission is included for future optional connections. No provider is configured and this build makes no model requests.
Original files, extracted page text, the local search index, and vault metadata are encrypted. Android Keystore protects the key using your device screen lock.
Cloud backup and device transfer are excluded. Uninstalling the app or losing its device key can permanently remove access. Keep your source files.
Screenshots and screen recording are blocked by Android. The vault locks when the screen turns off, after 15 seconds in the background, or when you tap Lock vault.
Files are imported and exported through the system picker. Exported copies are unencrypted and outside the vault’s protection.
This is an early development build. It has not received an independent security audit. Device compromise can affect these protections.
Content search could not complete. Name and type matches are shown. Try again.

Leaving the app can lock the vault. Return and unlock before continuing. Native initialization or cancellation may take time; this build cannot force-stop a hung native call.
